row.notes: cmp byte [rdi+0x18], 0 in Game_TelemetryLaps_OnNewLapRecorded (rsi telemetry laps, rdi the vehicle_newlap_recorded message, rbx telemetry lap slot 0). Every path past the car match reaches it (the ranking's exits at 0x1437b0d74..0x1437b0dfa, 0x1437b0e44, 0x1437b0e62, 0x1437b0eb7 and the fall-through at 0x1437b0ef2), after Game_TelemetryLaps_ApplyLapValidity_Thunk ran at 0x1437b0c0c and the lap time was stored, and before the lap start body (0x1437b0f05 with msg+0x18 set) copies slot 0 into slot 1 and clears it. Here bit 0 of [rbx+0x2c0] is the game's not-clean flag of the lap just closed and [rbx+0x268] its time (f32 s), with msg+0x10 the car and msg+0x14 the lap index. Steam 1.0.145 0x1437b3488 and EA 1.0.145 0x1437a0738 (restored dump): the containing function's 267 instructions are the same on both.
